name: ShopNotify – Personalized Cart Recovery for WooCommerce
author: WisdmLabs

sections.description:
WooCommerce Abandoned Cart Tracker with WhatsApp Notifications is a powerful plugin designed to help store owners recover lost sales by tracking abandoned carts and sending automated WhatsApp reminders to both logged-in and guest users.

With this plugin, you can:

  • Track abandoned carts of logged-in and guest users.
  • Send WhatsApp reminders with unique checkout links.
  • View detailed insights on abandoned and recovered carts.
  • Analyze recovery and abandonment rates along with cart values.
  • Manage and customize recovery reminders easily from the admin panel.

This plugin seamlessly integrates with WooCommerce and WhatsApp Business API to boost your store’s revenue and reduce cart abandonment.

Features

  • Cart Tracking: Monitor carts of logged-in and guest users in real-time.
  • WhatsApp Notifications: Send automated reminders with personalized checkout links.
  • Recovery Insights: Gain valuable insights into recovered carts and associated revenue.
  • Admin Dashboard: View detailed stats on abandonment and recovery.
  • Customizable Messages: Tailor WhatsApp messages to fit your store’s tone and style.
  • Easy Setup: Intuitive interface for quick and hassle-free setup.

Third-Party API Services

This plugin utilizes the following third-party API service(s):

  1. Edwiser Whatsapp Service: This Service is used for licenseing and free credits for whatsappp messages.

    • Documentation: [https://edwp.edwiser.org/documentation/]
    • Privacy Policy: [https://edwp.edwiser.org/privacy/]

  2. Edwiser Whatsapp Server: This Service is used for sending whatsappp messages.

    • Documentation: [https://waedwiser.wisdmlabs.net/documentation/]
    • Privacy Policy: [https://waedwiser.wisdmlabs.net/privacy/]

  3. Tally Feedback Form: This service is used for feedback collection.

    • Privacy Policy: [https://tally.so/help/terms-and-privacy]
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to your WordPress dashboard and navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Click on “Upload Plugin” and select the downloaded ZIP file.
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate Plugin”.
  5. On Activation you will be redirected to the plugin setup page.
  6. To use free whatsapp messages credits, you need to register at https://edwp.edwiser.org
  7. Purchase the credits from https://edwp.edwiser.org
  8. Enter the License key in the plugin settings Whatsapp setup page.
sections.faq:
What do I need to use this plugin?

You need an active WooCommerce store and a WhatsApp Business API account to send notifications.

Does it work for guest users?

Yes, the plugin tracks carts for both logged-in and guest users.

Can I customize the WhatsApp messages?

Yes, you can fully customize the reminder messages from the plugin settings.
